theme: A warm family backyard adventure about imagination, courage, and helping each other.
setting: The family's cozy home, their backyard at dusk, and a magical starry nighttime sky.
tone: Warm, playful, gentle, funny, emotionally satisfying.
coreLesson: Being brave is easier when your family helps and you remember you are loved.
notes: Star the whole family. Weave in each person's real interests: Metztli (age 9) is active and loves purple and leads; Sebastian (5) loves the outdoors, insects and bugs (and Shadow the Hedgehog energy); Shane (4) loves arts, crafts, and Ninja Turtles (Raphael); Dad is funny and physically active; Bridget is a calm yoga instructor. The family dog Zoey (a dog, no reference sheet) may appear as a background pet in prose/scenes but must NOT be listed in charactersPresent. Only the five people have reference sheets. Keep it a wholesome nighttime backyard quest of imagination where the kids are brave with their parents' help.
